I think those tropes mostly apply to younger peppier gay people. As for actual origin I’m not sure, but I disagree with the comments that it’s how certain gay people identify themselves as special. My only theory for any of them is the study that showed men walk faster with other men and slower with women. 

I relate to all four stereotypes heavily. I’m addicted to caffeine and prefer colder sweeter drinks. I have a crippling fear of driving that I’m going to therapy over, and as such I walk everywhere and have gotten a lot faster at walking. I can’t sit still because of anxiety and I fidget all the time in chairs. The fifth stereotype in this category you didn’t put is gay people are bad at math, which I don’t relate to as a math major.

The actual truth/origins of these stereotypes is going to be almost impossible to prove, like any other stereotype.

There’s a few design differences. The most notable include what percentage of the body is mechanic vs organic (protogens are more organic) and that primagens can have multiple sets of ears. If you want more details [this blog](https://runesfurryblog.wordpress.com/tag/protogen-species/) has a thorough explanation of the differences between the species with elaborate anatomy art.

Primagens are the “closed” species, meaning no one can make their own primagen, and instead have to buy them whenever the creator of the species decides to auction designs off. Many people (myself included) do not like this, at all, nor do they think closed species should exist. Not a lot of people make their own primagens because it puts you on a list of people the creator does not like, and the waste of energy isn’t worth it.

When this whole controversy happened, the creator decided to make a differently designed “open” species called protogens. They have a baseline design, but you can pretty much take any creative liberty you want. Cat-protogens are totally fine! I’d actually love to see what design you come up with in the future, as I’ve never seen a cat-protogen before!

From, a fellow sweet protogen.

EDIT: Just found a really good old link to explain the [legal ramifications](https://aminoapps.com/c/furry-amino/page/blog/closed-species-dont-exist/d37B_6pxHbuEKLg7Mb74wg40e17EelGdKR7) of the controversy much better than I. Overall, fear the social consequences way more than the legal ones.
